scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (process.env.WORKERS_CI || process.env.CF_PAGES) { execSync('npm install --no-save @opennextjs/cloudflare@^1.20.17 wrangler@^4.162.0 && npx opennextjs-cloudflare build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { execSync('npx next build', { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, NODE_OPTIONS: [process.env.NODE_OPTIONS, '--max-old-space-size=1024'].filter(Boolean).join(' ') } }); }"
scripts.build:cf: npm install --no-save @opennextjs/cloudflare@^1.20.17 wrangler@^4.162.0 && npx opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.deploy:cf: npm install --no-save @opennextjs/cloudflare@^1.20.17 wrangler@^4.162.0 && npx opennextjs-cloudflare build && npx wrangler deploy
